name: Nim
description: Classic three-pile Nim: remove stones from one pile each turn. Take the last stone to win.

strings.title: Nim
strings.hint: Take stones from one pile only. The last stone wins.
strings.choose_amount: Choose how many to take from pile {pile}
strings.server_illegal: Choose a legal move on your turn.

rules: Start with three piles of 3, 5, and 7 stones. On your turn remove one or more stones from exactly one pile. You may empty that pile, but cannot take from another pile in the same turn. The player who takes the last stone wins.
ui_instructions: Select a nonempty pile, then choose how many stones to remove. The highlighted pile is your selection. Take the last stone to win.

tutorial.text: Start with three piles of 3, 5, and 7 stones. On your turn remove one or more stones from exactly one pile. You may empty that pile, but cannot take from another pile in the same turn. The player who takes the last stone wins. Select a nonempty pile, then choose how many stones to remove. The highlighted pile is your selection. Take the last stone to win.
tutorial.html:
Nim

Start with three piles of 3, 5, and 7 stones. On your turn remove one or more stones from exactly one pile. You may empty that pile, but cannot take from another pile in the same turn. The player who takes the last stone wins.

Select a nonempty pile, then choose how many stones to remove. The highlighted pile is your selection. Take the last stone to win.
